backup_20260817_cells_relabel.description: PLANNED (not shipped as of Aug 2026): when a tutor passes the gate by naming a supervisor, that supervisor gets an automatic heads-up email so phantom authorizations surface immediately. Evidence: Aug 2026 proposal, Slack #plus-design-feedback.

PLANNED (not shipped as of Aug 2026): an overlap shorter than 10 minutes shows a soft warning the tutor acknowledges and proceeds; an overlap of 10 minutes or more blocks the sign-up until the tutor names the supervisor who asked them to take the session. Evidence: Slack #plus-design-feedback, Bill, 2026-08-04 (ts 1785871990.795529) — threshold revised from 20 to 10 minutes.

PLANNED (not shipped as of Aug 2026): threshold set by data analysis of production sign-ups — the 11-20 minute overlap band had the worst outcomes (5.84% mistake rate); the mistake multiplier was corrected from 8.5x to 4.3x and the call-off rate is flat at ~12% across bands, so the gate moved from 20 to 10 minutes. Evidence: Bill's corrected analysis, Slack #plus-design-feedback, 2026-08-04.
PLANNED (not shipped as of Aug 2026): proposed 2026-08-03, threshold revised 2026-08-04; explicitly "no rush over the summer" — design not yet triaged into a build card. Evidence: sweep 06 #6.

PLANNED (not shipped as of Aug 2026): confirmed sign-ups that went through a warning or gate carry the acknowledgement (and any named supervisor) so later call-off review has context. Evidence: Aug 2026 proposal.

PLANNED (not shipped as of Aug 2026): every sign-up attempt is compared against the tutor's current schedule before it is confirmed. Evidence: soft-conflict proposal, Slack #plus-design-feedback, Bill, 2026-08-03/04.

PLANNED (not shipped as of Aug 2026): a two-tier dialog in the Sign-Ups tab — acknowledge-and-continue for small overlaps, a gated form requiring a supervisor name for large ones. No Figma frames exist yet; proposal stage only.

PLANNED (not shipped as of Aug 2026): instead of vacating a slot outright, the tutor selects another session with capacity and trades their commitment — net coverage stays flat. Evidence: Figma section 5.5 (node 11227-394462), placeholder frame marked TBD.

PLANNED (not shipped as of Aug 2026): a swap would remove the tutor from one roster and add them to another in one operation; whether it produces a call-off record, counts as excused, or triggers student reassignment on the vacated session is undesigned. Evidence: Figma 5.5 TBD; open question noted in pre-session-call-off-request plan.
PLANNED (not shipped as of Aug 2026): whether swaps appear in the supervisor call-off review queue, and whether any swap needs approval, is not yet designed. Evidence: Figma 5.5 TBD.

PLANNED (not shipped as of Aug 2026): the vacated session disappears and the new one appears in My Sessions; no pending-review state since nothing awaits a decision. Evidence: inferred from Figma section 5 flow structure — 5.5 TBD.

PLANNED (not shipped as of Aug 2026): the "coming off sessions" entry point offers a third option alongside one-time call-off and recurring withdrawal — swap into another session. Evidence: Figma Pre-Session section 5 lists 5.5 Swap as a subsection, marked TBD.

PLANNED (not shipped as of Aug 2026): only a TBD placeholder exists in the design file; no interaction spec, no shipped code. Evidence: Figma 11227-394462; sweep 08 — no swap endpoints in CallOffRequestServiceImpl.
PLANNED (not shipped as of Aug 2026): section 5.5 is explicitly TBD in the design file — no PRD, no build card, no code as of the Aug 2026 sweep. Evidence: sweep 05 (Figma sweep); sweep 08.

PLANNED (not shipped as of Aug 2026): when a supervisor edits a session's time or reverts a cancellation with the notify toggle on, every affected tutor receives a reconfirmation prompt instead of a bare alert. Evidence: TutorScheduleServlet editSession notify fan-out (dev branch, Card 2452).

PLANNED (not shipped as of Aug 2026): tutors answer reconfirmation prompts singly or through the batch modal on the home page; confirming keeps their roster spot. Evidence: home.js:802 batch modal (dev branch); Figma sections 4.3 / 4.5.

PLANNED (not shipped as of Aug 2026): each affected TutorSession gets ReconfirmState PENDING; responses apply to the roster. Merged to dev 2026-08-06 (eb7d440a, Card 2452 / PR #1136) but production tutor_session has no reconfirm column yet. Evidence: sweep 07 #2; sweep 09 #5.

PLANNED (not shipped as of Aug 2026): a tutor answering Unavailable is dropped from the session without a call-off record; the freed slot feeds the fill-in pool. Bill confirmed 2026-08-08 this is by design — reconfirmation only fires on supervisor-initiated changes, so declining is not a call-off. Evidence: TutorSessionServiceImpl.java:236 (dev branch); decision note in pre-session-call-off-request plan.

PLANNED (not shipped as of Aug 2026): supervisors build and adjust the semester schedule directly in the app instead of the DB-import pipeline. In-app session creation is coming per Bill; edit scopes (single / all recurring / date range) and revert are already merged on dev (Card 2452 / PR #1136, 2026-08-06) but not deployed. Evidence: Slack, Bill (in-app session management direction, group DM 2026-05-18); sweep 07/08 — no session/shift creation UI exists anywhere today.

PLANNED (not shipped as of Aug 2026): edited and reverted sessions surface as alerts in My Sessions in production, each carrying a pending reconfirmation state until answered. Evidence: Figma Pre-Session section 4; dev-only today.

PLANNED (not shipped as of Aug 2026): editSession (single / allRecurring / dateRange) and revertSessionsWithScope exist on the dev branch (Card 2452, merged 2026-08-06); a creation flow does not exist yet — sessions still arrive via DB import. Evidence: sweep 08 SS-Job1-8; sweep 09 #5 (prod tutor_session has no reconfirm column, no revert traces observed).

PLANNED (not shipped as of Aug 2026): two cadence-triggered instruments replace one-size-fits-all prompts — a Self Reflection on every 10th completed session and a Form Feedback survey every 3 weeks. The exact cadence was still unresolved in the Jul 2026 review. Evidence: Slack #plus-design-feedback, 2026-07-15/23 (Bill future tense).

PLANNED (not shipped as of Aug 2026): active design work — Loom walkthrough by Cassie 2026-07-15; AI questions challenged (Cindy), chips endorsed (Emme), cadence unresolved. Evidence: sweep 06 #5; sweep 07 #5.

PLANNED (not shipped as of Aug 2026): the redesigned form adds escalation chips for flagging concerns and one AI-generated follow-up question per completed section, aimed at the ~80% of reflections whose free-text notes are empty today. Evidence: Cassie's Loom walkthrough, Slack #plus-design-feedback 2026-07-15 (ts 1784131068.897049); sweep 06 #5 / 07 #5 — design stage, zero AI in the live reflection code.

PLANNED (not shipped as of Aug 2026): the lead's scripted wrap-up reminder changes from "upload the recording" to "upload the recording or record why there isn't one". Evidence: reflection redesign contents, sweep 06 #5.

PLANNED (not shipped as of Aug 2026): the form gains chips and AI follow-ups, and the recording-upload widget adds a required No Recording Reason when no file is attached — closing the silent-missing-recording gap. Evidence: reflection redesign contents, sweep 06 #5.

PLANNED (not shipped as of Aug 2026): a chip selected in the reflection routes the concern to the supervisor queue rather than sitting in free text. Chips were endorsed by Emme in design review. Evidence: Slack #plus-design-feedback thread, 2026-07-15.

PLANNED (not shipped as of Aug 2026): an LLM reads each section's ratings/notes and asks a single targeted follow-up. The AI questions were challenged by Cindy in review and remain unresolved — this is the least settled piece of the redesign. Evidence: Slack #plus-design-feedback thread, 2026-07-15.

PLANNED (not shipped as of Aug 2026): the app tracks session counts and calendar intervals per tutor and surfaces the right instrument at the right moment. Evidence: reflection redesign contents, sweep 06 #5.

PLANNED (not shipped as of Aug 2026): acceptance kicks off the redesigned supervisor-registration clearance flow instead of the current roster-email handoff to the CPO. Evidence: Alex Houk, Slack, 2026-06-02 (trust redesign); sweep 10-clearance-procedure.

PLANNED (not shipped as of Aug 2026): the candidate still clears directly with the CPO — PLUS staff legally cannot verify documents — and the ~2-week external dependency remains the pacing constraint. Evidence: Alex Houk, Slack #plus-core 2026-04-01 (ts 1775065141.140149) and DM 2026-01-28; Jan-Feb 2026 cohort timing.

PLANNED (not shipped as of Aug 2026): the tutor follows the app invite, creates an account, and completes their profile — arriving at onboarding already clearance-verified. Evidence: Jun 2026 design, Alex Houk 2026-06-02.

PLANNED (not shipped as of Aug 2026): the CPO or school confirms clearance to supervisors directly; tutor self-reported clearance is legally unusable, which is the reason for the redesign. Evidence: Alex Houk, Slack, 2026-06-02.

PLANNED (not shipped as of Aug 2026): supervisors import the confirmed-cleared list into the app, which issues account invites — replacing the weekly CPO email, Friday 8pm ET plus_etl script, and ETL-only advisor.clearance_status as the gate. Evidence: Jun 2026 design (Alex Houk 2026-06-02); current ETL pipeline documented in sweep 10.

PLANNED (not shipped as of Aug 2026): invite link, account creation, and the existing Tutor Profile surface (preferred name, pronouns, photo, emails, languages) as the completion step. Evidence: MentorProfileServlet exists today (Card 2134 / PR #1132); the invite path does not.

PLANNED (not shipped as of Aug 2026): the whole flow is design intent from Alex Houk's 2026-06-02 trust redesign; no code or rollout evidence found in the Aug 2026 sweep. Evidence: sweep 10-clearance-procedure (unknowns section).

PLANNED (not shipped as of Aug 2026): an import surface for cleared tutors plus invite issuance; no such tooling exists in the codebase today (pending accounts do not exist at all — the gate sits before account existence). Evidence: sweep 10; sweep 08 (no registration/import UI).

PLANNED (not shipped as of Aug 2026): the candidate submits a structured info form (name, Andrew ID, contact) that seeds the clearance and later the account import — replacing ad-hoc acceptance-form data relay. Evidence: Jun 2026 design, Alex Houk 2026-06-02.

PLANNED (not shipped as of Aug 2026): a dedicated intake form owned by the clearance flow; whether it lives in the PLUS App or stays external is not yet designed. Evidence: sweep 10, Jun 2026 redesign section.
